review_evidence: BellaNova/ConstraintSystem.lean defines a ConstraintSystem typeclass with variable allocation and extensibility operations and a Circuit interface with synthesis, while LinearCombination.lean defines Index, Variable, LinearCombination and Indexer structures.
A complete scan of six Lean files found 15 declaration-style items and no theorem declarations.

Despite being small and early-stage, the constraint-system/circuit abstractions are reusable formal interfaces for cryptographic circuit formalization; FILTER-002 therefore requires retention rather than source retirement.
summary: Reviewed Bellanova.lean and retain its formal constraint-system and circuit interfaces.
